credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Sketch of a landscape done in graphite and watercolor. The top half of the paper is dominated by a large mountain in the background  and a plain of smaller hills in the foreground, all done in graphite. The bottom half of the paper contains O'Keeffe's handwritten notes about color and three watercolor splotches, one blue, one rusty red and one bluish lavender.
